description: This is a Java test source file for the BusinessEventNotifierServiceImpl class, containing unit tests for event notification behavior within transactions and external event posting.

classes.name: BusinessEventNotifierServiceImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for BusinessEventNotifierServiceImpl, testing event notification, transaction handling, and external posting logic.

classes.name: MockBusinessEvent
classes.description: A mock implementation of BusinessEvent used for testing purposes.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldCollectEventsWithinTransaction
methods.description: Tests that business events are correctly collected within a transaction and posted after commit.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldCollectEventsWithinTransactionInNestedTransaction
methods.description: Tests handling of nested transactions and event posting upon outer transaction commit.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldCollectEventsWithinTransactionInNestedRollbackTransaction
methods.description: Tests nested transaction behavior with rollback and ensures events are not posted if nested transaction is rolled back.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldCollectEventsWithinTransactionAndNotSendExternalOnRollback
methods.description: Verifies that no external event is posted if transaction rolls back.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldNotifyPostListeners
methods.description: Verifies that registered post-transaction event listeners are notified.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldNotifyPostListenersAndPostAnExternalEvent
methods.description: Ensures that external event posting occurs after transaction when configured.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldNotPostAnythingWhenNoEventWasRaisedExternalEventWhenRecordingEnabled
methods.description: Verifies no external event is posted if no event was raised but recording was enabled.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldNotifyPostListenersAndPostARegularExternalEventWhenRecordingEnabled
methods.description: Tests posting of external event after recording is started and stopped.

methods.name: testNotifyPostBusinessEventShouldNotifyPostListenersAndPostAnBulkExternalEventWhenRecordingEnabled
methods.description: Verifies posting of bulk external events when multiple events are notified during recording.

methods.name: testNotifyPreBusinessEventShouldNotifyPreListeners
methods.description: Verifies notification of pre-business event listeners.

methods.name: testNotifyPreBusinessEventShouldNotifyPreListenersWithoutPostingAnExternalEvent
methods.description: Checks that no external event is posted for pre-event notification if recording is enabled.
